, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread/misreported the Wikipedia page, claiming it “confirms” Rings is an “American psychological thriller film,” whereas the page clearly states it is an “American supernatural horror film.” This genre misclassification (omitting “supernatural” and substituting “thriller” for “horror”) steered the solution away from the correct composite genre “American supernatural psychological horror film,” making it the first clear factual error directly contributing to the wrong final classification.
